agent_notes: Normal TLS verification failed with the exact managed-proxy error: self signed certificate in certificate chain. curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests to the confirmed expected hosts www.nirfindia.org, www.bing.com, and mmmut.ac.in.
The NIRF 2025 Engineering, Management, and Overall listings each contain the exact institution name with Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh.

The central Programmes page contains a stale B.B.A. duration statement of three years, while the current Undergraduate Admissions :2026-2027 page states that the B.B.A. programme is four years; the current admissions page was used for the active programme record.
No separate active diploma or certificate programme was listed in the official central catalogue; diploma references on A_UG.aspx are eligibility routes for lateral entry.
B.Tech. and B.Pharm. lateral-entry listings, and Ph.D. QIP, were treated as admission routes or delivery schemes for the same degree programmes rather than duplicate degree records.
